annotations.title: Get a rehabilitation or long-term care hospital

description: The tool gets an inpatient rehabilitation facility or unit, or a long-term care hospital, by its six-character CCN. It returns the address, ownership, certification, Medicare use and each quality measure under the name in CMS's own data dictionary. It returns CMS's comparison category. It counts a rehabilitation measure that no held CMS document names, but does not show it. A rehabilitation unit names the hospital it belongs to.

ccn.description: The facility's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN).

name: get_rehab_hospital
